errors.text_span: Der Bereich im oberen linken Teil der Seite, unmittelbar über der Quellenangabe „Quelle: US Bureau of Economic Analysis (o. D.)“, in dem sich mutmaßlich eine Grafik befand, ist vollständig verschwommen und unkenntlich.
errors.evidence: The image does not contain any blurred or unrecognizable areas; the chart is fully visible and clear.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the chart illustrates the development of exports, imports, and the balance over time in billions of US dollars.
The description omits the x-axis label (years) and the y-axis labels (values in billions of US dollars for the left axis and balance for the right axis).
The description does not mention the presence of two lines (blue for imports and red for exports) and bars (representing the balance).
The description does not mention the legend at the bottom of the chart, which identifies the data series.
